Rule.name: Split Entitlement Profiles
Rule.Description:
Splits role profiles that hold several entitlement values into one profile per value, so that a Role Composition certification produces one reviewable row per entitlement.
DRY RUN BY DEFAULT. It reports what it would change and saves nothing until DRY_RUN is set to false.
THIS CODE HAS NOT BEEN COMPILED OR EXECUTED AGAINST IDENTITYIQ. Run it in a sandbox, in dry run, and check the report before you let it write anything.
